name: Caius' Training
intro: Ah, if it isn't our newest agent. Welcome to Morrowind. I'm Caius Cosades, the Imperial spymaster. I've got a series of lessons that'll get you up to speed on the local political landscape. Let's get started!
outro: Great work, recruit. The Empire is lucky to have an agent like you.

puzzles.name: Redoran Initiation
puzzles.description: Demonstrate your understanding of the Rally mechanic.
puzzles.flavor: House Redoran is a serious, honorable bunch with an impressive ability to rally their troops. Study their maneuvers for me.
solution: Play your 4 Sarethi Scions.
Attack the Lurking Mummy with both your Warclaw Mercenaries. Their Rally effect will buff the Ald'ruhn Arms Master up to 4/5.
Play the Ald'ruhn Arms Master in the Shadow Lane.
Attack face with Ald'ruhn Arms Master.

puzzles.name: Dagoth Initiation
puzzles.description: Learn how House Dagoth uses strength to its advantage.
puzzles.flavor: We've heard rumors that the lost house, "Dagoth" has returned. The may be strange looking monsters, but you have to respect their power.
solution: Play Hidden Trail.
Play Ash Piercer to the left lane. The buff from Hidden Trail is applied before the summon effect, so this card triggers its own summon effect.
Use the 3 damage from Ash Piercer to destroy the Blacksap Protector in the left lane.
Attack face with the Orc Clan Captain.

puzzles.name: Hlaalu Initiation
puzzles.description: Demonstrate your understanding of the Plot mechanic.
puzzles.flavor: House Hlaalu is constantly scheming to advance their business interests. I respect that about them. See if you can pick up the finer points of hatching a plot from them.
puzzles.notes: UESP header says 10 magicka; the screenshot shows 9/9 with Archer's Gambit at its pre-Patch-2.11 cost of 2. Our Archer's Gambit costs 3, so 10 magicka keeps the same budget.
solution: Play Glass Greaves on Dren Bodyguard.
Play Twin Lamps Consul to right field.
Use Archer's Gambit to move Twin Lamps Consul and deal damage to the Mountain Tyrant in the field lane.
Play Lower Canton Smith, and equip Dren Bodyguard with the Steel Scimitar.
Attack face with Dren Bodyguard.

puzzles.name: Telvanni Initiation
puzzles.description: Demonstrate your understanding of the Betray Mechanic.
puzzles.flavor: Watch your back around House Telvanni. They're wizards of great renown -- and even greater ambition. They'll use whatever, and whomever, they have to.
puzzles.notes: UESP header says 6 magicka; the screenshot shows 7/7, which the solution needs (Drain Blood 4 + Blood Sacrament 3).
solution: Attack Risen Dead with Young Mammoth.
Play Drain Blood, targeting Revered Guardian, and sacrifice Young Mammoth.
Attack face with Redoran Enforcer.
Play Blood Sacrament and sacrifice Redoran Enforcer.

puzzles.name: Tribunal Initiation
puzzles.description: Demonstrate your understanding of the Exalt Mechanic.
puzzles.flavor: The Tribunal Temple is the local religion. They worship three God-Kings: Almalexia, Vivec, and Sotha Sil. They've been known to exalt those they find worthy with great power. See if you can get on their good side.
solution: Play Orvas' Bargain. Debuff Colovian Trooper and buff Mournhold Pilgrim.
Play Ghostgate Defender and Exalt it. Deal 2 damage to Protector of the Innocent.
Play Grand Inquisitor and destroy Colovian Trooper.
Attack face with the Mournhold Pilgrim.

puzzles.name: Redoran Mastery
puzzles.flavor: This challenge is based on a historic Redoran victory. See if you can figure out how it's done.
solution: Play Silent Pilgrim.
Play Galyn the Shelterer and choose to copy Bolvyn Venim.
Play Close Call on Galyn the Shelterer.
Play Galyn the Shelterer and choose to copy Bolvyn Venim.
Play Bolvyn Venim.
Play Ald'ruhn Arms Master, equip it with Sentinel Battlemace, and attack with it. Its Rally effect will put 6 Bolvyn Venims into your hand.
Play every copy of Bolvyn Venim to fill the board. Choose to sacrifice Silent Pilgrim and Galyn the Shelterer to do so.
Play Mentor's Ring on Ald'ruhn Arms Master.
Attack with all creatures.

puzzles.name: Dagoth Mastery
puzzles.text: Survive for one turn to win.
puzzles.flavor: All right agent, let's see if you can use those Dagoth techniques you picked up to get out of this one alive.
solution: Play Feasting Hunger in the Field Lane.
Play Dune Smuggler in the Field Lane, moving a Hive Defender.
Play Stolen Pants on the Hive Defender in the Shadow Lane.
Play Servant of Dagoth in the Field Lane, sacrificing Feasting Hunger.
Hit the End Turn button.

puzzles.name: Hlaalu Mastery
puzzles.text: Your deck is empty. Win this turn.
puzzles.flavor: Let's see how much you learned from the Hlaalu. This challenge will require your most adroit plotting.
solution: Attack with the Nord Firebrand.
Attack the Dres Guard with Rampaging Minotaur.
Play Camonna Tong Heavy.
Play Cruel Firebloom on Camonna Tong Heavy.
Play Hlaalu Sharpshooter, targeting Nord Firebrand.
Play Journey to Sovngarde.
Play Sharp-Eyed Ashkhan.
Play and attack with Nord Firebrand and Rampaging Minotaur.
Play Camonna Tong Heavy in the same lane as Rampaging Minotaur (sacrifice one of the other creatures if necessary). Unsummon Rampaging Minotaur.
Play and attack with Rampaging Minotaur.

puzzles.name: Telvanni Mastery
puzzles.flavor: Time to see what they taught you in that Mushroom tower.
solution: Play Ancano and target Bone Colossus.
Play Cliff Strider.
Play Improvised Weapon on Cliff Strider.
Attack an enemy with Cliff Strider.
Play Traitor's Flames on the Field Lane.
Betray Cliff Strider, and play Traitor's Flames on the Shadow Lane.
Attack with Ancestral Dead.

puzzles.name: Tribunal Mastery
puzzles.flavor: Seems the gods have taken a shine to you. Show me what they can do.
solution: Play Ghostgate Defender in the Shadow Lane, and do not Exalt it.
Play Temple Patriarch in the Shadow Lane. Target an Indoril Archmage with Ghostgate Defender's attack.
Play Almalexia in the Shadow Lane, sacrificing Ghostgate Defender.
Attack Lurking Mummy with Mournhold Pilgrim.
Attack the weakened Indoril Archmage with Clockwork City Pilgrim.
Attack the remaining Indoril Archmage with Mournhold Pilgrim.
Attack with all remaining creatures.
